clock_and_reset_waveform.XIN: External clock input; ≤ 24.0 MHz; drives baud rate generator.
clock_and_reset_waveform.XOUT: Output of internal feedback inverter for crystal oscillator; unused when external clock is applied.
clock_and_reset_waveform.BAUDOUT: 16× baud-rate clock generated by the baud rate generator.
clock_and_reset_waveform.RCLK: Receiver clock input; typically tied to BAUDOUT.
clock_and_reset_waveform.MR_reset: Master Reset (active HIGH); ≥ 1 µs pulse width. Schmitt input with 0.5 V hysteresis.

serial_frame_waveform.start_bit: 1 bit-time LOW (drives mark→space transition); detected on SIN HIGH→LOW edge.
serial_frame_waveform.data_bits: 5-8 bits, transmitted LSB first; each bit lasts 1 bit-time (16 BAUDOUT clocks).
serial_frame_waveform.parity_bit: Optional 1 bit; even, odd, mark, or space per LCR.EPS/STICK.
serial_frame_waveform.false_start_rejection: Receiver re-samples SIN 8 BAUDOUT clocks after the start-bit edge; if still LOW, accepts start bit; otherwise rejects.

receiver_mid_bit_sampling.rule: Receiver samples each bit at the 8th of 16 BAUDOUT clocks (mid-bit), maximizing noise immunity.

write_cycle_timing.control_strobes: WR / WR with chip selected (CS0 + CS1 HIGH, CS2 LOW) and Register Select (A0-A2) stable.
write_cycle_timing.tADS_setup: Register-Select setup before WR rising edge.
write_cycle_timing.tADH_hold: Register-Select hold after WR rising edge.

read_cycle_timing.control_strobes: RD / RD with chip selected and Register Select stable.
read_cycle_timing.DDIS_low_during_read: DDIS goes LOW while CPU is reading from UART; can disable / direct an external bus transceiver.

interrupt_timing.tSI_initial: Delay from initial CPU write to first interrupt.
interrupt_timing.tSTI_stop: Delay from stop-bit edge to THRE interrupt.
interrupt_timing.tIR_reset: Delay from RD (IIR) to INTR reset.
interrupt_timing.tHR_reset: Delay from WR (THR) to interrupt reset.

modem_control_timing.tMDO: Delay from WR (MCR) to modem output change.
modem_control_timing.tRIM: Delay from RD (MSR) to interrupt reset.
modem_control_timing.tSIM: Delay from MODEM input change to interrupt set.

fifo_mode_timing_notes: Trigger-level interrupts and DR indication are delayed 3 RCLKs in FIFO mode.
Status indicators (PE/FE/BI) delayed 3 RCLKs after the first byte; immediate for subsequent bytes once RDR goes inactive.
Character timeout interrupt is delayed 8 RCLKs after the last RX char.

signaling_waveforms.Idle_J: D+ HIGH, D- LOW (FS) or inverted (LS); HS = both squelched
signaling_waveforms.K_state: D+ LOW, D- HIGH (FS) or inverted (LS)
signaling_waveforms.SE0: D+ LOW, D- LOW (used for EOP at FS/LS and for Reset)
signaling_waveforms.EOP_FS_LS: SE0 for 2 bit times + idle J for 1 bit time
signaling_waveforms.Reset: SE0 ≥ 10 ms driven by host or hub
signaling_waveforms.Resume_K: K-state ≥ 20 ms by host or 1..15 ms by device (remote wakeup)
signaling_waveforms.HS_chirp_K: Device drives K-state 1..7 ms after Reset to indicate HS capability
signaling_waveforms.HS_chirp_K_J_response: Hub responds with K-J-K-J-K-J alternating ≥ 50 µs each, ≥ 6 chirps
signaling_waveforms.GFSK_modulation: GFSK with BT=0.5; pre-modulation Gaussian low-pass filter applied before VCO frequency modulation
signaling_waveforms.LE_1M_eye_pattern: Defined by Section 4 of Vol 6 Part A; tolerated frequency deviation per symbol
signaling_waveforms.LE_2M_eye_pattern: Tighter due to higher symbol rate; same dF tolerance scaled to 1 µs symbol
signaling_waveforms.LE_Coded_S2_FEC: Block-coded BCH with rate 1/2 + 4-bit block; interleaved across 32-bit blocks
signaling_waveforms.LE_Coded_S8_FEC: BCH 1/2 + 8x repetition; effective rate 1/8 per uncoded bit

connection_event_structure.anchor_point_definition: First bit of the Master's first packet starts each connection event; the anchor recurs every Connection Interval.
